title: Grateful Dead Live at Paramount Theater on 1972-07-26
lineage: MSR > PCM > DAT > ZA2 > CDR x2

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard recording with a solid 1972 set highlighted by a smoking Dark Star > Comes A Time and gorgeous Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The show captures the Dead in fine form – a standard but well‑crafted set that really lifts off during the 30‑minute Dark Star and flows into a beautiful Comes A Time, with standout moments from Stella Blue and The Greatest Story Ever Told.  The soundboard source is generally clean and crisp, though a few listeners note an upfront vocal mix, slight tape‑speed slowness and occasional mic squeak.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.36/5; the majority praise both performance and sound quality, with only minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and clean overall; vocal mix a bit forward for some listeners, tape speed reported slightly slow by one reviewer, occasional mic squeak, but no major drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard 1972 set that feels solid throughout, gaining momentum after the Dark Star and maintaining a relaxed yet engaging vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Jerry's sweet tone and his interplay with Keith during the long Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentions of the “sweet sound of Jerry and Bob” and overall vocal presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Artistic interplay between Keith (keys) and Jerry noted; keyboards contribute to the spacious jam sections.
